summary: A world export: a JSON file, `<name>.world.json`, of content the server spawns once after resources have started, through the same APIs a script uses. List the files in the KCDS_WORLD_RESOURCES environment variable, separated like PATH. Exports belong to the server and last until it shuts down, and worldResourcesReady fires when all have loaded. The format is { level, props: [{ model, position, rotation, scale, physics, dimension }], effects: [{ effect, position, ...Vfx options }], lights: [{ position, color, intensity, radius, castShadows }], world: [LevelEdit definitions], areas: [Area.create definitions], patrolRoutes: [PatrolRoute.create definitions] }. All lists are optional, and a file with an error adds nothing.

ready.summary: Whether all listed exports have loaded.

all.exampleLua:
for _, worldExport in ipairs(kcds.world.WorldResource.all()) do
  print(worldExport.name .. ": " .. tostring(#worldExport.props) .. " props from " .. worldExport.path)
end

find.summary: The export with this name, the file name without .world.json, or null.
find.exampleLua:
local market = kcds.world.WorldResource.find("market")
if market then
  print(market.loaded, market.level)
end

record.summary: The export's raw record as loaded, or null.

level.summary: The level it was made in.
level.exampleLua:
if worldExport.level ~= "trosecko" then
  print(tostring(worldExport.name) .. " was made in " .. tostring(worldExport.level))
end

props.summary: Props it spawned that still exist, in file order.
props.exampleLua:
for _, prop in ipairs(worldExport.props) do
  prop:destroy()
end

effects.summary: Effects it spawned that still exist.

lights.summary: Lights it spawned that still exist.
lights.exampleLua:
for _, light in ipairs(worldExport.lights) do
  light.intensity = 0.5
end

items.summary: Ground items from it that are still there, in file order. Its items list has { item, position, rotation?, amount?, name?, quality?, health?, condition?, dimension? }, working like GroundItem.spawn.
items.exampleLua:
local harvest = nil
for _, stack in ipairs(worldExport.items) do
  if stack.name == "harvest" then
    harvest = stack
    break
  end
end
if harvest then
  print(tostring(harvest.amount) .. " left at the market")
end

doors.summary: Doors it created that still exist, in file order. Its doors list uses Door.spawn definitions, { model, position, rotation?, name?, locked?, lock?, canBePicked?, lockLevel?, lockKey? }, plus dimension?. The server owns them, so they last until shutdown. Level doors it removed appear in levelEdits and Door.removed instead.
doors.exampleLua:
local village = kcds.world.WorldResource.find("village")
local barn = nil
for _, door in ipairs((village and village.doors)) do
  if door.name == "barn" then
    barn = door
    break
  end
end
if (barn and barn.locked) then
  print("the barn is locked")
end

smartObjects.summary: Smart objects it created that still exist, in file order. Its smartObjects list has { blueprint, position, rotation?, name?, dimension? }, working like SmartObject.spawn. Dice tables and crafting stations behave like the level's. Level stations it removed appear in levelEdits instead.
smartObjects.exampleLua:
local tavern = kcds.world.WorldResource.find("tavern")
local diceTables = 0
for _, object in ipairs(tavern and tavern.smartObjects or {}) do
  if object.kind == "dice" then
    diceTables = diceTables + 1
  end
end
print(diceTables .. " dice tables in the tavern")

areas.exampleLua:
local square = nil
for _, area in ipairs(worldExport.areas) do
  if area.name == "square" then
    square = area
    break
  end
end

patrolRoutes.summary: Its patrol routes that still exist.
